  unresolved for every purpose, never imputed; counted in gate (d)'s unresolved
  accounting; in the quote's executed-slot cost census they carry 0 µ$ (they ran;
  the WAL attributes zero calls).
- **WAL cost authoritative** — arm-regrouped 19,250,389 µ$ vs the recorded window
  total 19,250,397; the 8 µ$ residual is the lane-probe non-slot attribution,
  recorded verbatim as `non_slot_attribution_micros`, never refused.
- **Activation honesty** — V1/V2 measured 1.0 via served-effort receipts; V6
  deterministic 1.0; V5 → `unmeasured{evidence_absent}` (request bodies absent from
  the committed corpus); V3/V4/V7 conditional → unmeasured, gate (c) fails. No
  fabricated pass.
- **Fidelity** — `served_model` census `glm-5.3-flash×10602`; 10,602 completed calls
  == 10,602 attributed receipts; per-arm declared-vs-served effort: 0 mismatches.
